summary: Tested role conversion feature (Admin/Viewer/Dirigente/Coordinatore) end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest OK. Frontend: full flow works VISUALLY after rebuilding stale expo dist bundle (dirigenti page long-press → 3 role buttons; perms modal 9 checkboxes with 4-preset selection; badge COORDINATORE + '4/9 sezioni' counter; revert coord→dirigente OK; dual-role autonomous switch: Lella lands on /coordinatore, /dirigente shows 'Passa a Modalità Coordinatore' card). CRITICAL INFRA ISSUE: /app/frontend/dist was stale (built 08:29 UTC, before E1's 09:29 changes). Supervisor 'expo' serves the dist folder statically via `npx serve -s dist`, so hot reload does NOT apply — every code change requires `npx expo export --platform web` + supervisor restart. Testing agent rebuilt the bundle. Also noticed data-testid on <TouchableOpacity>/<Modal> children DOES NOT propagate to the DOM in react-native-web; visible text and functionality work, but automated tests using [data-testid=...] selectors will fail. Lella restored to viewer at end.

ui_bugs.issue: In react-native-web, plain JSX prop `data-testid="..."` on <TouchableOpacity> is NOT forwarded to the underlying DOM element. All 12+ testids added by E1 (btn-make-admin, btn-make-dirigente, btn-make-coordinator, btn-edit-coordinator-perms, btn-save-coordinator, coord-perm-*, coord-perms-count-*, switch-to-dirigente-btn, switch-to-coordinator-btn, dirigente-coord-switch-card, coordinatore-role-badge) return count=0 in the DOM. Visually the UI works, but automated E2E tests using these selectors will fail. Use `testID="..."` (RN prop) or `dataSet={{testid:'...'}}` on the wrapping <View>, or wrap the pressable in a plain <div data-testid=..>.

When Lella (role=coordinatore) navigates to /dirigente, the page shows 'Impossibile caricare gli impegni' + 403 errors on admin-only endpoints (/api/dirigente/impegni or similar). Layout accepts coordinator role but API calls need to be relaxed OR redirected.

action_items: IMPORTANT: Every frontend code change MUST be followed by `cd /app/frontend && npx expo export --platform web && sudo supervisorctl restart expo` — the current supervisor config serves the pre-built /app/frontend/dist folder via `npx serve`, so hot-reload does NOT apply. Consider adding a rebuild step to the CI/dev workflow or switching expo supervisor to `npx expo start --web` for live reload.
OPTIONAL (test-only fix): replace `data-testid="..."` with `testID="..."` on TouchableOpacity/Modal children so selectors work in automated e2e tests (visible functionality is unaffected).
MINOR: relax the 403 blocking on /dirigente for coordinatore users (impegni endpoint) or hide/skip those API calls when role=coordinatore.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend build pipeline serves stale bundle — E1 changes were invisible until manual rebuild. High risk of silent regressions in preview env.
TouchableOpacity does NOT forward `data-testid` prop through react-native-web; use `testID` (auto-mapped) or wrap in View to guarantee DOM propagation.
Backend PATCH /users/{id}/role correctly filters invalid permission keys, enforces admin-only + multi-tenancy (checked in tests). No changes needed.
